reasonEn: The input imposes a counterfactual initial condition — that a distinct Christian religion never arose — rather than asking about the existing world. Read by the ordinary, most conservative interpretation, this is a never-arose premise, not a later erasure of Christians and not the removal of Jesus of Nazareth or of Jewish messianic activity. The divergence is anchored, as a chosen assumption, at c. 30 CE, the conventional focal date of the crucifixion and of the earliest Christ-believing movement, after which the movement is modeled as remaining a current within Judaism rather than becoming a separate, enduring religion. This is a material historical change of the first rank, earth-scoped, and is admissible.
reasonZh: 该输入施加的是一个反事实初始条件——一个独立的基督教从未兴起——而不是对既有世界的提问。按最普通、最保守的解读，这是“从未产生”的前提，而非后来对基督徒的清除，也不等于抹去拿撒勒的耶稣或犹太教的弥赛亚活动。分歧点作为选定假设锚定在约公元30年，即钉十字架与最早信奉基督的运动通常聚焦的年份；此后该运动被建模为留在犹太教内部的一股潮流，而未成为独立且延续的宗教。这是头等重要的物质性历史改变，范围限于地球，可以受理。

completions.en: No year given; the divergence is anchored at 30 CE, the conventional focal date of the crucifixion and of the earliest Christ-believing movement, so that 'never emerged' means never arose rather than a later removal.
completions.zh: 未给出年份；分歧点锚定于公元30年，即钉十字架与最早信奉基督的运动通常聚焦的年份，因此“从未出现”意为从未兴起，而非后来被清除。

completions.en: Earth-scoped, centered on Roman Judaea and the Mediterranean world where the movement originated, with the later missionary expansion simply never occurring rather than being suppressed.
completions.zh: 范围限于地球，以运动发源的罗马犹太行省与地中海世界为中心；后来的传教扩展只是从未发生，而非遭到压制。

completions.en: Jesus of Nazareth is retained as a historical Jewish preacher; what is removed is the emergence of a durable, trans-local religion centered on him.
completions.zh: 拿撒勒的耶稣保留为历史中的犹太传道者；被移除的是一个以他为中心、跨地域且延续的宗教之兴起。

completions.en: Second Temple Jewish messianic and apocalyptic currents, Judaism, and all other religious and philosophical traditions are preserved and continue to develop on their own terms.
completions.zh: 第二圣殿时期的犹太弥赛亚与启示潮流、犹太教以及所有其他宗教与哲学传统均予保留，并按自身逻辑继续发展。

completions.en: Modeled as a point change at the divergence year; the absence simply becomes historically evident over the following decades without any additional intervention.
completions.zh: 建模为分歧年份的点状改变；这一缺席在随后数十年中自然成为历史事实，无需额外干预。

causalBridge.mechanism: Without a durable Christ-believing movement, the trans-local network of assemblies, appointed overseers, shared letters and a forming canon never comes into existence.
Absent that network, there is no Christian constituency, clergy or scripture for later imperial, legal and cultural actors to patronize, persecute, convene or transmit.
Downstream consequences for later Mediterranean and European institutions are left to be simulated rather than asserted here; they are conditional hypotheses, not established results.

operations.target: emergence of a distinct, enduring Christian religion
operations.description: At the focal point of the earliest Christ-believing movement (c. 30 CE), the movement does not develop into a separate, self-reproducing religion. No distinct Christian assembly network, episcopate, canon or self-identifying gentile church arises; the messianic ferment around Jesus remains a current within Second Temple Judaism and its later Rabbinic development.
operations.temporalBasis: Chosen assumption: conventional dating of the crucifixion to c. 30 CE, the event around which the distinct movement formed; the user supplied no year.
assumptions: Never-arose reading, not later erasure of Christians.
Jesus of Nazareth and Jewish messianic activity are not removed.
All unrelated peoples, religions and institutions persist unchanged at the point of divergence.
No new mechanisms or physical laws are introduced; the change is an initial-condition edit only.

operations.target: status of Jesus of Nazareth and Jewish messianic currents
operations.description: Jesus of Nazareth remains a historical Jewish preacher whose following does not outlive its initial milieu as a separate religion; Second Temple Jewish messianic and apocalyptic currents continue and are reshaped by the events of 66-70 CE on their own trajectory.
operations.temporalBasis: Chosen assumption consistent with the non-erasure default and the c. 30 CE divergence anchor.
assumptions: Preserves persons and movements not entailed by the premise.
Subsequent Jewish history is not treated as determined by this edit.
